question: In 1978, the _______ to the Constitution removed the right to property from the list of Fundamental Rights.
solution:
The correct answer is __**44th Amendment.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 44th Amendment of 1978 **removed the right to property from the list of fundamental rights.
 
• A new provision,** Article 300-A, was added to the constitution.**
 
• **Which provided that "no person shall be deprived of his property save by authority of law.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 42th Amendment Act was** enacted in 1976.**
 
• The 46th Amendment has** empowered the states to tax the value of goods involved in a work contract in same manner as it did when contracts were separable.**
 
• **The 43rd Amendment Act was enacted in 1977.**
